subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

In his speech on dowry, he __set forth__ his views at length.
solution:
The most appropriate meaning of the idiom **"set forth" **in the given sentence is **option 3) explained.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"set forth"** means to present, describe, or explain something in a detailed or organized manner. (व्याख्या)
 
• In the context of the sentence, it indicates that the speaker expressed and elaborated on their views on dowry extensively during their speech.

**Therefore,** the correct answer is: **'Explained'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hid: **"Hid" means to conceal or keep something out of sight. (छिपाना)
 
• **Ran: **"Ran" typically refers to the act of moving swiftly on foot or operating or managing something. (चला गया) 
 
• **Started:** "Started" refers to the beginning of an action or process. (शुरू हुआ)
